scope: Historical local native Wasm and closed/replacement Alchemy workerd with actual R2, recorded before SDK/runtime 0.23.0 publication and deployment. See sdk-0.23.0-delivery.json for delivery status. This is not a production latency, CPython parity or cost claim.

reproduction.definitions: 0.22.0 BlockExpr returns final function/class objects and JSON serialization fails. Native parser classifies final declarations for Exec; final expressions retain BlockExpr.
reproduction.locks: RustPython eagerly imports its frozen Python _thread during bootstrap. Registering a native module alone does not replace that sys.modules entry; the guest now installs its native definition after bootstrap and before user imports.
reproduction.threadingFeature: The upstream threading feature trapped on wasm32 during construction, including a one-billion-fuel diagnostic. It was removed; no fuel/memory limits were raised.
